canonical_detector_order: ascending UTF-8 bytes of source_family || 0x1f || detector_id
deduplication_rule: byte-identical retries collapse; conflicting values or references reject the FeatureVector

empirical_cdf.cohort: root-deduplicated finite values from negative training revisions only
empirical_cdf.normalizer_artifact: ordered detector_id, N, sorted IEEE-754 binary64 values, and tie rule; RFC8785/SHA-256 digest

D.eligible_values: one CDF-normalized value per deduplication key with observation=detected and a legal raw value
D.fewer_than_k: mean the min(3,n) available normalized values
D.zero_eligible: D=0 placeholder; Scope Resolver must emit kappa=out_of_support, decision_eligible=false, eligibility_reason=no_eligible_detector_value, and P=null

q.definition: q_s=1 iff at least one deduplicated registered detector from source s has observation=detected, a legal finite value, and an evidence root tied to a core entity or selected episode edge; otherwise q_s=0
